title: Live for Productivity
coreMove: Carry the chosen priority into protected execution where visible output follows from focused action.
sourcePressure: Part 3 turns priority into productivity, defined as concentrated execution of the chosen first claim rather than busyness or output theater.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Equating productivity with busyness, speed, or a larger count of completed tasks.

hook: A single choice changes the whole day
The real priority is hiding under the busy work
Live for Productivity as a generic focus opener
counterintuition: Focus is harder than it looks
tryThisNow: Set a timer and list priorities
Write down your one thing without a concrete context
examples: generic office worker choosing email or strategy

exampleSpecs.stakes: a permit filing depends on one ramp section
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she closes the inbox, pins the ramp section at full scale, and works until the permit-ready drawing exists
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a full-scale ramp section taped under a drafting lamp

exampleSpecs.stakes: hospital readmissions stay high without the visit protocol
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he chooses a two-hour protocol build over attending a status huddle and leaves with the first visit script ready
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a blank home-visit protocol on a clipboard beside an ambulance key ring

exampleSpecs.domain: independent game studio bug triage before release
exampleSpecs.stakes: one save-file bug can erase players' progress
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she predicts clearing small bugs will feel productive, then protects three hours to reproduce and fix the save bug
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a crash log frozen above a saved-game folder on a test laptop

exampleSpecs.stakes: buyers cannot order until the SKU sheet is real
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he stops rearranging sample trays and finishes the SKU sheet line by line until purchasing can use it
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a spreadsheet of blank SKU rows beside sealed cookie samples

exampleSpecs.stakes: the season opener depends on one inspection binder
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she turns away dock chatter and completes the safety binder section that lets the inspector sign off
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a salt-stained inspection binder weighted open by a brass compass

exampleSpecs.stakes: a child waits for device approval
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she sees the productive hour was the report submission, not color-coding therapy materials around it
exampleSpecs.firstImage: an AAC device approval form beside a box of picture cards

tryThisNowSpec: Block one uninterrupted execution window for the current priority and define the visible output that must exist when it ends.
